act.scope: All 740 C-movable signal pins; other original pins fixed. B is only the identical C cohort, not necessarily the complete B candidate. Full C can fail despite pilot success. Aopt only permutes existing slots within each original candidate group, edge and layer, using C-center distance as a proxy; group semantic/assumption is inherited, not a global optimum or real wire cost.
